name: pi-skin-sjdonado
description: My skin for running a harness in Pi. pss opens the skin.

scripts.check: TMP=$(mktemp .check-out.XXXXXX); trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT; tsc --noEmit --pretty false > "$TMP" 2>&1; CODE=$?; awk '/\([0-9]+,[0-9]+\): error TS/ { show = ($0 !~ /^node_modules\//); if (show) print; next } show { print }' "$TMP" | tee /dev/stderr | grep -q 'error TS' && exit 1 || { grep -q 'error TS' "$TMP" || [ "$CODE" -eq 0 ] || exit "$CODE"; exit 0; }
